title: Record Pod site history - Feature request
body:
Hello, it's optional but would be super helpful, Like on the Omnipod Dash PDM, to be able to log pod site used and be able to review the history. That way we could keep track of it :)

![Screenshot_20211105-230358_PDF Extra](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/87416963/140584052-4fa66f94-6350-4fa4-bb0a-3cb7aafa9cb3.jpg)

![Screenshot_20211105-230447_PDF Extra](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/87416963/140584053-ca0d7fc8-3c54-407e-8d56-aa37bc60fd49.jpg)

Hope somebody could make this possible 🙏
